displayPattern: Status LED: 3 short flash(es) then 4 long flash(es) (code 34)
meaning: Ignition proving failure: flame not sensed during trial for ignition. Control tries 3 more times before lockout 14.
causes: Gas valve defective or turned off, or manual shut-off valve closed
Inadequate flame carryover or rough ignition
Control ground continuity problem (green/yellow wire must be connected to furnace sheet metal)
diySteps: Check that the manual gas shut-off valve is open and the gas valve is ON
Technician: clean flame sensor with fine steel wool and check flame current (0.5 microamp DC minimum, 4.0-6.0 nominal)
Technician: check igniter, gas pressure and ground
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if gas is on and the code persists.
